d: Written, sung, arranged and produced by the legendary John Fogerty and recorded by American rock band Creedence Clearwater Revival, “Fortunate Son” has become an iconic global music phenomenon. Having amassed billions of streams worldwide, this banger was released on the band's fourth studio album, Willy and the Poor Boys in October 1969. It had previously been released as a single, with CCR’s "Down on the Corner" on the flip side, in September 1969.
